title: Cybersecurity & Zero Trust
businessQuestion: How do automated agent exploits force transition to continuous cryptanalytic architectures?
investorQuestion: Which security platforms consolidate enterprise spend across identity, network, and endpoints?
overview: Security records skew commercial because buyers adopt controls on procurement cycles, not research timelines. Identity, zero trust and AI-assisted detection dominate the set. The open question is whether agentic security tooling creates a durable new layer or simply becomes a feature bundled into existing platforms, compressing margins for standalone vendors.
